universal_obligations: Use the existing supervised worker for untrusted parsing; bound acquired input, pages/items, output, elapsed time and process memory. A resource boundary alone is not a filesystem/network/process sandbox.
Preserve original source bytes and extraction; describe every derivative/transformation and its source/page identity. Never overwrite the input or publish partial artifacts after failure.
Use fallible APIs and explicit Unsupported/Partial/Limit/error states. Successful serialization, empty results, or smoke tests do not prove complete extraction, fidelity, compliance, or security.
No private keys, real signatures, credentials, persistent MCP service, model downloads, arbitrary external resources or user-controlled filesystem paths are implicitly authorized.
Keep one integration owner/checkpoint branch. Existing backlog PR heads, repository visibility/license, protected branches, releases and parent holds remain unchanged.
Test only approved synthetic/repository/public fixtures in disposable workers with finite deadlines and memory caps. No destructive/unbounded host tests.

capabilities.obligation: Bound immutable bytes before parse; use fallible page count; distinguish malformed/encrypted/wrong-password/unsupported cipher and zero-page input.
tests: encrypted empty/correct/wrong password over private request channel
oversized input and huge page range

capabilities.obligation: ParserOptions exists, but PdfDocument::open_with_config ignores its argument. Do not advertise effective tunable document limits from this hook.
tests: limit enforcement in adapter/worker independent of parser options

capabilities.obligation: Expose only bounded necessary object summaries; preserve object-reference provenance without following arbitrary paths or recursive cycles.
Retain finite source geometry and rotation with explicit one-based engine versus zero-based upstream page mapping.
Retain text, source glyph uncertainty, geometry, font, size and sequence; bound character and string totals.
Map each granular representation honestly and preserve extraction settings and geometry; do not equate word/span counts with correctness.
Prefer bounded selected-page processing; whole-document text accumulation must obey finite limits and preserve partial/error status.
Inventory independent geometric, XY-cut, structure-tree, simple and article-thread behavior; route only with evidence and retain selected strategy.
Preserve region roles, source page/boxes and reading order; heuristic role labels remain uncertain.
Validate finite rectangles and filter semantics; preserve original extraction and report whether containment or intersection was requested.
Use direct rows/cells with headers, row/col spans, boxes and MCIDs; do not substitute Markdown or line-role labels. Bound tables/cells/text.
Preserve path operations/transforms/style without treating vector counts as complete rendering; bound path operations.
Retain classification signals, reasons, source, Partial/OCR-required statuses; no implicit model downloads or unsupported OCR success.
Retain actual category/message plus known adapter stage/page provenance; never fabricate region provenance absent upstream data.

api_declarations.name: WarningCategory
attributes: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]

capabilities.obligation: Bound returned font bytes and nested resources; preserve embedded-font/width/Unicode provenance and dependency/font notices.
Bound pattern length, pages, matches and cache lifetime; preserve boxes and case/regex options without hidden whole-document scans.
Use bounded traversal of outline Next/First references; destinations remain data, not actions.
Distinguish label text from source page number; existing-document label mutation has no direct editor setter in reviewed surface.
Preserve Info and XMP separately with bounded XML/text; do not merge inconsistent values silently.
Use pinned &ConversionOptions signatures and bounded page-wise conversion; retain original output and transformation settings.

Application owns escaped wrappers and deterministic page IDs. Sanitize untrusted HTML/links/image sources; no scripts/event handlers/external fetch. image_output_dir must never be document/model chosen.
Optional derived transformation only; preserve original text/spans and record exact options. Whitespace/code/table formatting changes may lose meaning.

Use a separate document for cleanup masks; bound whole-document scans and require conservative positive thresholds. Tagged early return can leave mixed pages untreated. Masks are not destructive redaction.

Bound count, decoded pixels and individual/total encoded bytes plus process memory. Default filters/HTML max pixels do not universally limit inline decoding. Empty list does not prove image-free. Pinned PdfImage has no to_jpeg_bytes helper; preserve original JPEG data or verify a separate encoder.
Raw upstream disk-writing helper must not accept arbitrary paths. Optional artifact publication uses app-confined staging and atomic publication, preserving image provenance.
Bound input text, geometry, page count and generated bytes; save fallibly in memory and identify font/encoding limits.
Bound Markdown parsing/layout and supplied fonts; verify actual supported syntax and report unsupported image/link behavior.
Simple HTML conversion is distinct from HTML/CSS layout; do not claim browser fidelity or run scripts/resources.

Separate supported CSS layout path with explicitly supplied font bytes. Current image callback handles data URIs only and can omit invalid images; bounded parsing/rendering and omission diagnostics required.
Prefer byte APIs with prevalidated format/dimensions; do not accept arbitrary image paths. Preserve encoding/alpha/color warnings.
Expose bounded typed pages/text/path/image/graphics operations with finite numeric inputs and fallible byte output.
Separate table creation from detection. Bound cells/rows/layout, repeated headers and streaming buffers.
Distinguish supplied/embedded/system fallback fonts and subsetting/shaping. Preserve font licenses; disallow arbitrary private filesystem reads.
Creation-only setters must not be misrepresented as existing-document editing. Bound trees/destinations and active actions.
Bound payload/dimensions/output and report supported barcode types; generation does not provide barcode scanning/decoding.
Preserve original and return distinct derivative; validate page selections, duplicates, rotations and geometry before work.
Bound total input/pages and process outputs sequentially; avoid eager expansion of huge user ranges and raw path helpers.
Review bounded outline traversal, normalized filenames, depth/range handling and output count before exposing bookmark splitting.
Typed DOM/query/edit surface must preserve selected elements/resources and disclose structural reconstruction uncertainty; bound queries/edits.
Bound image data/dimensions and transforms, retain identity and distinguish placement edits from pixel replacement.
Record which Info fields changed, preserve unchanged fields; XMP updates require separate verified API support.
Full rewrite/incremental/linearized output are distinct obligations; no fallback to silent Pdf::into_bytes or predictable temporary-file helper. Never promise secure erasure from incremental save.
Bound fields/Kids traversal and values; support explicit text/check/radio/choice semantics and properties without evaluating actions/scripts.
Retain flatten warnings and verify visible appearances/AcroForm removal; success alone does not prove preservation.
Use bounded in-memory writers and staged field state. Review FDF names escaping and XFDF arrays; file export helpers may read original source instead of pending edits.
Bound XML, packet/field counts and conversion; scripts/calculations/dynamic layout must remain unsupported unless specifically implemented and verified.
Preserve subtype/geometry/target provenance and support only explicitly bounded mutations. URI/action values remain untrusted inert data.
Return warnings and verify appearance preservation; do not call an overlay redaction or security sanitization.

Public construction types exist; exposing active media/actions is separate from inert inspection. No playback, external execution or resource loading; explicit unsupported operations until bounded handling is verified.
Attachment names are metadata, never paths; bound name/count/individual/total bytes and never open/execute extracted data.
Report encryption/authentication and declared PDF permissions separately from application authorization; passwords stay out of argv/logs.
Support explicit fallible byte transforms and authenticated full rewrites; preserve original, record changed encryption and avoid claiming policy enforcement by PDF permission bits.
Separate true destructive rewrite from erase masks/annotations. Reject unsupported XObjects/inline images/marked alternate text/tagged structures/annotations where complete removal is not verified.

attributes: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Default, PartialEq, Eq, serde::Serialize)]

capabilities.obligation: Precisely report sanitized object classes and remaining content; limited catalog/Info cleanup must not claim complete sanitization or malware removal.
Inventory provider/policy/algorithm metadata; do not mutate global security settings or load HSM/KMS credentials in this task. FIPS build flag alone is not a deployment certification.
Use bounded field traversal and bounded signature bytes; original upstream Kids recursion needs cycle/depth containment.
Report structural/digest/cryptographic checks distinctly; no implied chain trust, current revocation, trusted timestamp, or system-root validation.
Source capability inventory only until explicit authorized key-material contract and bounded synthetic verification. No private-key access or real document signing is authorized.
HTTP timestamp client is network- and credential-capable; do not enable/call implicitly. Local timestamp parsing is separate from external TSA acquisition.
Return exact upstream checks/errors/warnings by requested level; no formal certification or validator weakening.
Preserve accessibility check scope and limitations; declared tagging/alt text does not establish usable reading order.
Report exact print-production checks by level, output intents and missing dependencies; do not claim press fidelity.
Return conversion action report AND fresh unmodified validation result. Converter warning downgrade or placeholder output intent is not compliance proof.

Validate page/DPI/pixels/bytes before allocation and expose actual rendering omissions. Public renderer loads host fonts; requires reviewed font confinement or explicit supported environment before enablement.
Bound plate count and aggregate pixels/bytes; report spot/process color handling and ICC dependencies.
Upstream helper uses PID-named temporary files and accumulates all page paths. Do not expose it as in-memory/no-disk; implement bounded staged alternative or explicit unsupported status.
Diagnostic overlays are bounded derivatives, never canonical extraction or source render proof by themselves.
Explicit feature/model/runtime contract, hash-verified authorized model bytes, pixel/time/memory limits and missing-model errors; no automatic downloads.
Model manifest may be exposed as inert metadata. Prefetch performs network/cache writes and unbounded read_to_end; retain disabled status in this adapter.

capabilities.obligation: Distinguish classical fallback from ML execution, model/runtime availability and selected strategy; no accuracy claim without fixture evidence.
Feature pulls ml and pdfium-render; native PDFium/model dependencies and actual callable model path require separate verified availability. Do not substitute heuristic tables as ML success.
GPU/ORT dependencies are optional and platform-dependent; no GPU execution claim from feature names or CPU fallback.
Record qcms versus native lcms2 and JPEG2000/JBIG2 support. No silent CMYK/profile substitution; missing codec must be explicit.

DOCX/XLSX/PPTX byte conversion requires ZIP entry/total/decompression/XML-depth/sheet/image budgets and rejection of macros/OLE/ActiveX/external relationships; preserve font/system dependency provenance.
All outputs allocate owned ZIP bytes. Record positioned versus flow strategy and transition thresholds: DOCX/PPTX above 30 pages, XLSX above 200. Editable elements do not establish fidelity.
Dependency has legacy DOC/XLS/PPT readers; current PDF adapter byte methods do not establish legacy support. Guard CFB sector chains/macros/OLE and fidelity before exposing.
Direct Office dependency includes creation/editing/IR interfaces beyond PDF bridge; inventory separately, with format-specific limits and no implied direct adapter coverage.
Use existing bounded application queue and per-file failure/backpressure. Upstream helpers return whole-corpus/page Vecs and arbitrary path IO; do not expose unbounded collection as streaming.
tests: one failed file does not drop others

capabilities.obligation: Bound threads/cache/document lifetime. Office may spawn parsing threads with a 16 MiB stack; root process budgets and existing worker limits must include them.
